user_design_intent: Explore how a compact home could address the reported Glan direction.
Compare one-volume, courtyard and split-volume spatial strategies.
Keep every study reversible until the legal and survey gates close.
hard_constraints: Keep preview massing inside the indicative municipal display polygon.
Do not claim a legal setback, access, finished-floor level or buildable envelope.
Do not convert a preview action into an approved or selected design.
soft_objectives: Orient primary living mass toward the reported southern view direction.
Use the derived relative display surface to compare compactness and stepping.
Retain a legible arrival side from Säterdalsvägen without asserting legal access.

candidates.label: A · View bar
candidates.summary: A compact timber pavilion places a panoramic living façade and continuous deck toward the reported view direction.
design_signals: Smallest footprint and simplest structural span in the set.
Continuous southern deck and panoramic bays test an indoor-outdoor living edge.
A recessed porch keeps the arrival legible without claiming legal access.
No view, access, earthwork or planning performance has been verified.

candidates.label: B · Courtyard edge
candidates.summary: Two timber wings and a light courtyard portal define a sheltered outdoor room while leaving the southern edge visually open.
design_signals: Largest footprint and most spatially enclosed strategy in the set.
The two wings and courtyard arcade create a protected garden hypothesis.
A portal and covered threshold distinguish arrival from the living terrace.
No wind, privacy, setback or entitlement performance has been verified.

candidates.label: C · Split terrace
candidates.summary: Two mono-pitch timber pavilions, a glazed link and stepped decks test a sectional response to the relative display terrain.
design_signals: Intermediate footprint and most articulated terrain-response hypothesis.
The glazed link and opposing mono-pitches make the two pavilions legible as one home.
Stepped decks express the level change without asserting actual cut and fill.
No surveyed levels, foundation, accessibility or drainage performance has been verified.
